headline: Earnings rebound q/q but trail last year sharply
summary_short: Yantai China Pet Foods' Q2 FY2026 EPS was ¥0.1738, up about 42.3% q/q from ¥0.1221 but down roughly 54.1% y/y from ¥0.3789.
summary_long: EPS of ¥0.1738 in Q2 FY2026 rose about 42.3% q/q from ¥0.1221, but fell roughly 54.1% y/y from ¥0.3789 a year earlier. No revenue, margin, or cash-position figures are available from verified shard data for this kpi-only pass; no other metric was resolvable within the search/fetch budget.
